# CWE-798: AWS AppSync GraphQL API key — da2-... hardcoded.
# AppSync keys allow unauthenticated GraphQL access if leaked.
# ruleid: detected-aws-appsync-graphql-key
appsync_key = da2-1234567890abcdefghijklmnop
# ruleid: detected-aws-appsync-graphql-key
key = da2-abcdefghij1234567890abcdef
# ok: detected-aws-appsync-graphql-key
key = da2-short
# ok: detected-aws-appsync-graphql-key
not-a-key = hello world
# ruleid: detected-aws-appsync-graphql-key
appsync_key = da2-qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbn1
# ruleid: detected-aws-appsync-graphql-key
key2 = da2-0987654321abcdefghijklmnop
# ok: detected-aws-appsync-graphql-key
key = da2-short
